div.div:
Solid entity links: declared PG FK / Mongo ORM. Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.
Audio checkpoints UNIQUE(indexAttemptId,segmentNumber). Graph checkpoint/write keys are compound IDs.
EmbeddingCacheEntry is intentionally unconnected: cacheKey derives from kind/stable ID/input hash/model and algorithm versions; no declared FK ties it to a semantic row.
Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists.

text.tspan: Solid entity links: declared PG FK / Mongo ORM. Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.

Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists.
